message.content:
[
  {
    "pattern_id": "P-LIT-SMELL-REPAIR",
    "decision": "APPLY",
    "rationale": "The workflow performs a REUSE compliance check which typically involves scanning files. While the action itself is a black box, adding a cache for the action's internal state or dependency-related files (if any were present) is the standard way to address configuration smells related to redundant work. Since this is a specialized compliance action, I will implement a cache step for the repository content to see if the action can leverage it, although the primary benefit in this specific case is speculative due to the nature of the 'fsfe/reuse-action'.",
    "workflow_yaml": "on:
  push: null
  pull_request: null
  workflow_dispatch: null
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  reuse-compliance-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Cache REUSE data
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            .reuse
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-reuse-${{ hashFiles('**/.reuse') }}
      - name: REUSE Compliance Check
        uses: fsfe/reuse-action@v6
"
  }
]
